title: ThirstyFLOPS: Water Footprint Modeling and Analysis Toward Sustainable HPC Systems
problem: Water footprint of HPC systems is poorly understood despite growing water-intensiveness from cooling and power generation; environmental impact underexplored
motivation: HPC systems consume massive water for cooling; power generation also water-intensive; water scarcity is growing concern; sustainability metrics needed for HPC planning
method: ThirstyFLOPS framework: region-specific metrics (WUE, PUE, EWF); analysis of four representative HPC systems (Marconi, Fugaku, Polaris, Frontier) with real-world data; impact assessment of water scarcity and nuclear energy
key_novelty: Comprehensive water footprint analysis framework for HPC; region-specific sustainability metrics; guidance for water-aware HPC infrastructure design
contributions: Implications for HPC planning and management
hardware_target: Large HPC systems (Marconi, Fugaku, Polaris, Frontier)
limitations: Water measurement data availability may vary; regional water pricing factors not discussed
primary_theme: Environmental sustainability assessment of HPC systems
